statement: DL v2.4.0 S9 acceptance profile: 100 alpha sessions behind one tier identity per venue x environment, the real mix (continuous feeds on Stream; warmup, reference and funding reads polled on demand), the Trading System writer unchanged, and the sealed manifest quotas (no bump). Prepared offline; never run against production by this change.

workload.streams: each session's continuous feeds (the realistic 40/30/20/10 class mix)
workload.on_demand_polls: warmup at start, then reference/funding-like reads once per 60 s per product
workload.sdk_min: 2.8.0 for the session header; 2.x without it uses the identity as fairness key

restart_storm.measures: start offsets of 100 sessions, every warmup outcome (including SDK retries), every 429 seen by any session, TS writer warmup/snapshot latency during the storm

noisy_neighbour.measures: one session offers >= 50 rps of snapshot/reference reads; it must see RATE_LIMITED; every other session of the same identity and the TS writer see none

g14_baseline_subtracted.dl_vcpu_source: scripts/p184_g14_resource_table.py cpu_mean over the DL roles of each phase, each phase >= 10 min
g14_baseline_subtracted.limit_status: OWNER-APPROVED 2026-11-18 (alpha delta <= 0.5 vCPU, baseline-subtracted: idle, then writer only, then writer + 100 alphas; relayed by the coordinator); recorded, never edited after results
